title: Grant Thornton Bharat CASEQuest
summary: Grant Thornton's case competition for arts and commerce undergraduates: a video prelim, semi-finals and a finale, with internships for top teams.
eligibility: BBA, BCom, BA, BSc and other arts/commerce UG students at recognised institutions. BTech students are not eligible.

prize.description: ₹1.5 lakh cash: ₹75,000 + PPI (winner), ₹50,000 and ₹25,000 + live projects/internships for runners-up.

notes: Registration usually runs from mid-September with the prelim in October–November; the official page doesn't show this year's dates.
